title: Rogers Corporation Announces Investor Day on September 30, 2026
summary: Chandler, Arizona, September 9, 2026: Rogers Corporation today announced that it will host an Investor Day on Wednesday, September 30, 2026, in New York City.
body_markdown:
##### Release Date: 09/09/2026


Chandler, Arizona, September 9, 2026: Rogers Corporation (NYSE:ROG) (“Rogers”) today announced that it will host an Investor Day on Wednesday, September 30, 2026, in New York City. Rogers’ President and CEO Ali El-Haj and other members of the senior leadership team will provide details on Rogers’ strategy, key growth opportunities, capital allocation priorities and multi-year financial objectives. The event will include formal presentations from Rogers’ management team, followed by a question-and-answer session.


The event will begin at 9:00 a.m. ET and is expected to conclude by approximately 11:30 a.m. ET. Due to limited capacity, in-person attendance is by invitation only. A live webcast of the event, presentation materials and an on-demand replay will be available through the Investor Relations section of Rogers’ website at[www.rogerscorp.com/investors](https://www.rogerscorp.com/investors) .


#### About Rogers Corporation


Rogers Corporation (NYSE:ROG) is a global leader in engineered materials to power, protect and connect our world. Rogers delivers innovative solutions to help our customers solve their toughest material challenges. Rogers’ advanced electronic and elastomeric materials are used in applications for EV/HEV, automotive safety and radar systems, mobile devices, renewable energy, wireless infrastructure, energy-efficient motor drives, industrial equipment and more. Headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Rogers operates manufacturing facilities in the United States, Asia and Europe, with sales offices worldwide. For more information, visit www.rogerscorp.com.
